---
name: writing-clearly-and-concisely
description: Rewrite the current MDX text to be clear, direct, and concise (Strunk-style) without changing meaning.
agent: edit
---

Apply the rules from this skill doc:
[Skill: writing-clearly-and-concisely](../../.github/skills/writing-clearly-and-concisely/SKILL.md)

Target:
- If I have a selection, rewrite only that.
- Otherwise, rewrite the section I’m currently working on in the active editor.

Constraints:
- Do NOT change technical meaning, API names, field names, parameter names, headers, code blocks, or examples.
- Keep MDX structure intact.
- Prefer short sentences, concrete verbs, and fewer fillers.

Output:
- Edit the text directly (not a separate rewritten copy).
